project_context.description: Enterprise Talent Management System for PT PP Presisi Tbk. Needs to handle high-density data, CRUD operations for employees and movements, and complex demographic analytics.
project_context.target_audience: HR Admins, Managers, and Corporate Executives

typography.strategy: The 'Swiss Brutalist' Corporate approach: structural, legible, and authoritative.
typography.font_installation_instructions: Import 'Chivo' and 'Karla' from Google Fonts and configure them in tailwind.config.js.

rules: Use 'Grid Borders' strategy: rely on 1px borders (#E2E8F0) instead of shadows to separate content.
Never use pure black or pure gray. Always tint grays with blue (e.g., slate).
Use High-Contrast Text: text-slate-900 for main text, text-slate-500 for secondary.
Hover states must be explicitly defined and accessible.

layouts_and_grids.spacing_system: Generous Tailwind padding (p-6, p-8) around main sections, but tight spacing (p-3, p-4) inside high-density data tables and cards.
layouts_and_grids.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6. Every pixel utilized.
layouts_and_grids.navigation: Fixed left sidebar (w-64) with dark theme (#0B1120) to contrast the light content area. Top header with breadcrumbs and user profile.
layouts_and_grids.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, NO shadow. Very sharp, 4px border-radius (rounded-sm or rounded-md max).
layouts_and_grids.tables: High density, text-sm, 1px bottom borders on rows. No alternating row colors, just clean white with hover:bg-slate-50.
layouts_and_grids.modals: Use Shadcn 'Sheet' (Slide-over drawer) from the right for 'Talent Profile' and 'Talent Movement Form' to maintain context of the underlying list.

components.strategy: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for structural page layouts. Use Shadcn UI for all interactive logic.
components.forms: Strictly Shadcn Form + React Hook Form + Zod. Use Shadcn Select, Input, DatePicker.
components.tables: Shadcn Table. Ensure horizontal scrolling for many columns (NRP, Name, Position, Work Unit, etc.).
components.charts: Shadcn Charts / Recharts. Bar charts for Education Level, Pie/Donut for Employment Status, Line chart for Movement Trends.
components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-sm). Primary buttons use #0F4C81, secondary buttons use border with transparent bg.
components.tabs: Use Shadcn Tabs for navigating within the Talent Profile (e.g., Personal Info vs Movement History).

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: GRID BORDERS (The Technical Look). Expose the skeleton, make the grid visible. Container uses border-collapse style layout if possible, or just strict borders.
visual_enhancers.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a technical, crisp, dashboard feel.
visual_enhancers.motion: Minimalist. Hover states on rows, subtle slide-in for drawers (Sheet). Recharts drawing animations.

login_background.description: Modern buildings under construction at sunset
login_background.usage: Use as the hero image covering the right side of the split-screen login page. Overlay with bg-slate-900/40.

heavy_equipment_accent.usage: Optional: Use for empty states in the dashboard (e.g., 'No data found' card) with a very low opacity or greyscale filter.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for normal text. Use APCA standards. Text on primary blue must be white.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. Add data-testid to all buttons, inputs, links, and table rows (e.g., data-testid='login-submit', data-testid='talent-row-123').
accessibility.focus_states: All inputs and buttons must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react recharts sonner date-fns react-hook-form @hookform/resolvers zod
Initialize Shadcn UI and add: button, input, select, table, sheet, dialog, form, label, card, tabs
Implement a persistent Sidebar Layout where the sidebar contains links to Dashboard, Talent List, Talent Movement, and Master Unit Kerja.
Build the Login page with a split layout: left side white with corporate login form, right side image overlay.
The Dashboard must have at least 4 Recharts components visualizing Headcount, Status, Education, and Movement Trends.
The Talent List must be a dense table. Clicking a row should open a right-side Sheet (Drawer) containing the 'Employee Full Profile' and their 'Movement History'.
The Talent Movement interface should be a robust form inside a Dialog or Card, requiring fields like SPT Number, Effective Date, Type (Promosi/Mutasi/Demosi), New Position, New Work Unit.
Implement generic Shadcn Toasts (Sonner) for all CRUD success/error states.

Apply the GRID BORDERS strategy: don't use heavy shadows for cards, use clean 1px borders (border-slate-200) with square or slightly rounded corners (rounded-sm) to fit the technical construction industry vibe.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Create depth through layered design elements, but stick to the Grid Borders strategy.
Do NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Target specific properties.
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭) for icons. Use the specified Phosphor Icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable for main layout padding, but keep tables dense.
Add hover states to every interactive element.
